turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    C --> C1[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    C1 --> C2[Compress to floor content]
    C2 --> C3[Name evaporated content]
    C3 --> C4[Find operative sentence]
    C4 --> C5[Report ratio, erosion, and missing rough edge]
    C5 --> C6[Output residue and finding]
    C6 --> C7[This is a finding, not a draft.]

    B -->|Draft prompt| D[PROVIDE]
    D --> D1{Mode stated or inferable?}
    D1 -->|No| D2[Ask for mode]
    D2 --> D1
    D1 -->|Yes| D3[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    D3 --> D4{Floor passes?}
    D4 -->|No, three or fewer gaps| D5[Ask one question]
    D5 --> D3
    D4 -->|No, four or more gaps| D6[Ask three largest questions]
    D6 --> D7[State assumptions for the rest]
    D7 --> D3
    D4 -->|Yes| D8[Compress the prompt]
    D8 --> D9{Cut removed specification?}
    D9 -->|Yes| D10[Revert the cut]
    D10 --> D8
    D9 -->|No| D11{Two empty cuts?}
    D11 -->|No| D12{Floor still passes?}
    D12 -->|Yes| D8
    D12 -->|No| D13[Return the last passing version]
    D11 -->|Yes| D14[State that the contract is minimal]
    D13 --> D14
    D14 --> E[Output prompt, Cut, and required notes]
    E --> F[Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?]
    F -->|Keep negotiating| D8
    F -->|Valid human freeze| G{Execution tools available?}
    G -->|No| H[Gate stays closed]
    G -->|Yes| I[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    I --> J{Result}
    J -->|Success| K[Done]
    J -->|Floor failure| L[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    L --> D8
```
